lines: A war once lasted thirty-eight fucking minutes. Sit your ass down.
Octopuses have three goddamn hearts. And blue blood.
Three hearts, and the bastard still won't text you back.
In the eighteen-thirties, ketchup was sold as fucking medicine.
A doctor sold tomato pills. Quack-ass bastard.
Russia is wider than Pluto. The whole goddamn thing.
Pluto got bodied by a country. Sad little bitch.
In eighteen ninety-six, Britain fought Zanzibar. Shortest war in history.
Thirty-eight minutes. Shorter than your shitty lunch break.
So how long was that war? Comment, dumbass.
